name: EXAMPLE ONLY - format reference, not a concept

concept.summary: Illustrative only: a small timber cabin on concrete pads, one builder.

bibles.location: a grassy clearing ringed by birch trees under soft overcast light
bibles.structure: a 3 x 4 m timber cabin on six concrete pads
bibles.builder: one builder: dark beard, black beanie, charcoal hoodie, tan canvas work pants, work gloves
bibles.materials: pads and lumber are delivered to the left of the site and stay visible until used

cameras.wide: high wide view from the front-left corner, whole site and the material stack in frame
cameras.close: chest-height view of the front wall from 3 m

checkpoints.title: Empty site
checkpoints.state: the mown clearing with a pallet of concrete pads and a lumber stack at the left

checkpoints.title: Pads set
checkpoints.state: six concrete pads set level in two rows; the pallet at the left is empty

materials.concrete pads: the pallet at the left of the site

checkpoints.title: Floor frame
checkpoints.state: a timber floor frame bolted onto the pads; the lumber stack is smaller

materials.floor frame: the lumber stack at the left

checkpoints.title: Front wall studs
checkpoints.state: front wall studs standing on the floor frame

materials.front wall studs: the lumber stack at the left

checkpoints.title: Walls and roof complete
checkpoints.state: all walls and the roof framed and sheathed

materials.walls and roof: the lumber and sheet stacks at the left, now nearly used up

beats.task: carries a pad from the pallet and levels it in the first row
beats.after: three pads set level in the front row; three pads left on the pallet at the left; the back row is bare grass

causal.first_touch: the top concrete pad on the pallet at the left
causal.tool: gloved hands and a spirit level (on the pallet)
causal.tool_source: the pallet of pads at the left of the site
causal.method: He lifts one pad, carries it four steps and lowers it into the first-row position, then lays the level on it.
causal.stationary: the lumber stack, the pallet and the pads already set
causal.progress: one pad carried and set level
causal.frontier_start: no pads set | front row | back row untouched
causal.frontier_end: front row filling | back row untouched

beats.task: sets and levels the last pad of the back row

causal.first_touch: the last pad on the pallet
causal.tool: gloved hands and the spirit level
causal.method: He carries the pad to the back-row gap, sets it down and taps it level with the heel of his hand.
causal.stationary: all pads already set, the lumber stack
causal.progress: the last pad of the back row set level
causal.frontier_start: front row set | back-row gap | nothing beyond

beats.task: carries two joists from the stack and lays them on the left pads
beats.after: two joists lie on the left pads; the lumber stack at the left is two joists smaller; the middle and right pads are bare

causal.first_touch: two joists on top of the lumber stack
causal.tool_source: the lumber stack at the left
causal.method: He shoulders two joists, walks them to the pads and lays them across the left pads.
causal.stationary: the pads and the lumber stack
causal.progress: two joists laid on the left pads
causal.frontier_start: bare pads | left third | middle and right untouched
causal.frontier_end: left joists laid | middle | right untouched

beats.task: drills the rim joist to the joists in the middle
beats.after: the rim joist is fastened across the left and middle joists; the right third has no frame yet

causal.first_touch: the rim joist lying on the left joists
causal.tool: a cordless drill and screws (from his tool belt)
causal.method: He holds the rim joist against the joist ends and drives screws through it.
causal.stationary: the joists already laid, the pads
causal.progress: the rim joist fixed across the middle
causal.frontier_end: left and middle framed | right untouched

beats.task: bolts the last corner of the frame to its pad

causal.first_touch: the corner bracket at the last pad
causal.tool: a socket wrench and a bolt (from his tool belt)
causal.method: He sets the bracket, pushes the bolt through and tightens it.

beats.task: nails the last front wall stud into place against the level

causal.first_touch: the last front wall stud lying on the floor frame
causal.tool: a nail gun and a spirit level
causal.method: He stands the stud upright against the level and fires two nails through the bottom plate.
causal.frontier_start: front wall studs but one | last gap

beats.task: slow pull back from the front wall to the wide view as the light fades; nothing is built
